entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Compiler output cache drops warnings and changes MSBuild -warnaserror results #86198
  • Investigate eliminating unused synthesized struct `this` loads in async methods #86195
    .NET 12
  • Formatting depends on unrelated code: tied indent operations are ordered by an unstable sort #86191
  • CS8629 and CS8604 are reported despite null checks after three left joins in query syntax #86188

Closed

  • Inconsistent handling of side effects around "unused" `this` access in structures #85965
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix IDE0058 assigning to existing _ symbols #86197
    VSCode
  • Migrate Roslyn Integration CI DartLab pipeline to DartLab1ES #86196
  • Remove project-system InternalsVisibleTo grants #86194
  • Add project-system APIs to Visual Studio ExternalAccess #86192
  • Re-apply "Scope compiler server mutexes per-user" #86190
    Area-Compilers
  • Replace disallowed dependency in FBA update action #86189
    Area-Infrastructure, Feature - Run File
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #86186

Merged

  • Make evaluation of side effects for unused expressions more consistent across different expression forms #86134
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Keep FBA sources synced #86120
    Area-Infrastructure, Feature - Run File, Next
  • Document trust model for roslyn-language-server tool #86193
    Next
  • Add test coverage for existing Razor component import precedence behaviour #86187
    Area-Razor
  • Migrate Document Outline to Fluent TreeView #82761
    Area-IDE, Community, Needs UX Triage, Next

Updated

  • Migrate Advanced options to Unified Settings and keep EditorConfig pages legacy #86163
    Needs UX Triage
  • Preserve owned test processes and collect timeout dumps after launcher exit #86150
  • Let F# Find All References results carry pre-classified line text #85281
    Area-IDE, Community
  • Rank and highlight F# Navigate To results like C# and VB #85280
    VSCode
  • Test that a diagnostic without a help link has no code description #85740
    VSCode
  • Let a language without a Roslyn compilation take part in unit testing #85117
    Community, VSCode
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3115405 #86046
    Area-Razor
  • Unify ref safety analysis of embedded vs block statements #86019
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Ref Locals and Returns
  • Unsafe evolution: add csc flag and msbuild property #85980
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Unsafe evolution: make address of uninitialized var unsafe #86017
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Migrate inheritance margin UI to Fluent #86153
